_meta.description: Ranger subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: crit, armor pen, evasion.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la chance de critique de 0.5% et les dégâts critiques de 0.8% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases crit chance by 0.5% and crit damage by 0.8% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente la pénétration d'armure de 1% et la précision de 0.3% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases armor penetration by 1% and accuracy by 0.3% per level.

subclass_passives.description_fr: Augmente l'ATK de 0.8% et l'esquive de 0.5% par niveau.
subclass_passives.description_en: Increases ATK by 0.8% and evasion by 0.5% per level.
